blocking_focus: Complete the candidate-bound Tester MCP state matrix.

preservation_constraints.requirement: Keep frozen technical baseline `native_godot_project` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

Keep frozen technical baseline `host_godot_boot` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

task_specification.objective: Restore the complete player contract for guidance, automatic combat feedback, upgrade decisions, run completion/retry, and authored-arena spatial integrity while preserving the existing cemetery package, ArenaCamera ownership, InputMap, and native Godot baselines.

diagnosis.root_cause: The current run has two host-gated player-facing defects: first-run guidance omits required combat and lifecycle stages, and automatic lantern attack/impact events do not reach an audible mixed output. The PRD's complete-run contract also still needs a deterministic successful Result/Retry route. Audio has repeated prior treatments, so this iteration must repair authoritative signal routing rather than repeat transform or asset tuning.

stop_conditions: Do not schedule deferred camera-occlusion, exposure, or dense-performance investigations as separate work items.
Do not replace the preserved authored cemetery or camera assets without new package-incompatibility evidence.
Stop after the three bounded task families are implementation-ready and host recapture can directly judge each acceptance predicate.

strategy.rationale: Use a materially different root-cause strategy from prior tuning: make guidance, audio, upgrade choice, and Result/Retry depend on explicit authoritative run-state and combat signals, then isolate spatial validation in the lifecycle/world binding. Keep each family independently retestable and avoid cosmetic-only or telemetry-only fixes.

code: Run static parse/import checks and targeted tests for guidance milestones, InputMap/device label derivation, upgrade eligibility/value deltas, audio signal routing, five-wave/Bellkeeper completion, and Retry reset.

White-box inspect authoritative run-state, weapon/audio adapters, pooled-actor cleanup, collision/navigation bindings, and lifecycle receipts; verify native_godot_project and host_godot_boot preservation.
runtime: Host recapture a fresh run through movement, dash, automatic attack, death-drop, collection, upgrade, waves, Bellkeeper, Result, Retry, and a fresh run; collect runtime_state/log receipts proving ordered guidance, one report per attack input, completion reason, and reset generation.
Capture mixed Effects/Master audio for one attack and one quick AUTO tap, then verify audible bounded transients, source timestamps, separated impact/spatial cues, stop-on-release, and reset silence.

Replay spawn, critical route, central landmark, and perimeter traversal with ordinary movement; verify larger traversable scale, external depth, aligned collision, and no disappearance/occlusion drift.
Capture Result and Retry with keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus at shipped resolution; verify summary readability, upgrade-card hierarchy, guidance illustration, and clean fresh-run HUD.
visual: Inspect run-start guidance, each staged prompt, upgrade draft, Result, and Retry/fresh-run screenshots for readable hierarchy, authored illustration, live glyphs, distinct focus states, and unobstructed arena composition.

Recapture representative cemetery gameplay from spawn, critical route, landmark, and perimeter views to confirm preserved authored streets/structures, central building visibility, collision alignment, and stable ArenaCamera framing.

done_when: The first-run sequence visibly teaches movement, dash, automatic attack, death-position drop, pickup collection, first upgrade choice, and Result/Retry stages in concise contextual prompts.

Prompts are rendered from the authoritative InputMap/current device with recognizable keyboard or controller glyphs, have ordinary keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus/dismissal, and do not consume combat input or pause the run after dismissal.

At least one authored or model-generated gameplay illustration is bound into the guidance sequence using a HUD-free candidate frame; it matches the shipped camera, character, arena, and art direction while text and button glyphs remain live UI.

Upgrade cards lead with truthful weapon/upgrade silhouettes, compact stat icons, and no more than three current-to-new decision-relevant deltas; unchanged rows and NEW/LOCKED placeholders are omitted, and keyboard/mouse/gamepad focus states are distinct.
Fresh-run reset exposes deterministic guidance state and generation receipts; guidance does not reappear on Retry unless the explicit QA reset is requested.
Same-session black-box retest verifies ordered guidance and a readable upgrade draft at shipped gameplay resolution.

Retry starts a fresh authoritative run with reset wave, health, XP, upgrades, guidance policy, audio, pause ownership, pooled actors, and reset generation; no stale enemies, overlays, or duplicate sounds remain.

The authored arena provides larger traversable scale where required, a coherent external world/external depth, and a readable central building/landmark; its collision aligns with visible geometry and prevents pass-through.

Boundary/perimeter traversal under ordinary movement/movement replay preserves stable landmark visibility without disappearance or camera occlusion; no proxy floor replaces native authored streets or structures.
Result, Retry, and reset remain reachable with keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus, and lifecycle receipts expose run id, completion reason, and reset generation.
